title: ALP Platform Content Mapping v2
description: Platform-owned mapping (ADR-0017) from one Learning Target's declared-stable items (ADR-0057) to ALP competencies, each with a Mapping Role (ADR-0058). Validated by `alp platform mapping validate`. Schema version 1 (flat competencies[] without roles) is not accepted: roles cannot be inferred, so v1 mappings must be rewritten as v2.

platform.description: Platform identifier; must match the validating adapter.

target.description: Opaque, platform-owned Learning Target ID this mapping covers.

packs.description: Domain packs the mapped competencies belong to, each with a semver compatibility range. A competency belongs to the pack whose domain is its ID prefix.

item.description: Declared-stable item ID of the target, as listed in its curriculum export.

strengthCeiling.description: Optional cap on the evidence strength activity on this item may yield. Strength itself comes from the adapter's signal policy and the observed result.

role.description: Mapping Role. Only assesses may yield assessment-grade evidence.
